items: Label worker command activity as "Last worker command" with "Command running/completed/failed" badges, so a failed `harness run` no longer reads as the run failing; while the run is still working and a checklist step is open, a failed command is shown in amber with "run still in progress". The panel keeps the latest command and its parents instead of flipping to an older failed one when a heartbeat is late. "View operation log" now opens the log (from the monitor step on a finished run), step files reopen from their link, and a link that cannot open says why
